facts.fact: The Universal Access and Service Fund subsidises communications services in unserved and underserved areas and ran 2024-25 projects for 4G mobile networks and broadband internet in rural areas, with a 2029 goal of 100% rural connectivity.
The Universal Access and Service Fund reports 51 more villages given 4G mobile network connectivity in 2024-25, bringing 279 villages connected by March 2025, plus 37 highway sites.
